Subject: Idea: one subagent per product for the support bot

Elliot —

Random thought after watching a few support transcripts: the support bot probably wants one subagent per product (hosted, embeddings, batch, dedicated). A dedicated-billing subagent could carry the contract rules without cluttering the main agent's context for hosted questions.

Just an opinion — haven't run it past Dev or product, and there's no decision behind it. Filing it here so it doesn't get lost.

Connor
